lines.speaker: mei
lines.text: Morning, Viktor! Same as always, or are you feeling brave today?

lines.speaker: viktor
lines.text: Same as always. Bravery is for people who haven't had their coffee.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.text: Ha! Look, I tried a new pattern on the foam. It's meant to be the old footbridge.

lines.speaker: viktor
lines.text: Hm. The arch is wrong, but it's a fine likeness. Well done.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hi Mei, how's your morning going?

lines.speaker: mei
lines.text: Busy, but good! Viktor actually liked my latte art. Can you believe it?
